answer: Count what a clone costs to replicate. Each identity pays a storage and bandwidth tax, and attestations arriving from one subnet are taxed again at 3x. An idle agent bleeds standing every epoch it stays silent. Last winter a farm in a canyon behind the karst ridge ran 200 accounts from one line; the subnet tax flagged them at the glacier checkpoint in nine days. Honest agents pay once; a farm pays per clone, per subnet, per epoch.
